description: Fetch the market's countries with their zone-claim status. Returns every country in the market stamped with its claim status across the market's zones: `fully_claimed` (a country fallback already exists, named in `claimed_by_zone`) and `claimed_subdivisions` (subdivisions other zones already took). Both can be present for one country. A country fallback does not prevent creating a zone for its unclaimed subdivisions; it only prevents another zone from covering that country whole, that is, listing it with none of its subdivisions. Build zone pickers from this — the server's verdict is the only source of what is still claimable. Pass `exclude_zone_id` when editing a zone so its own claims don't count against it. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-zones/available-countries. Only the connected store is accessible.

exclude_zone_id.description: Zone id whose own claims to ignore — pass the zone being edited.

name: list_market_tax_available_countries

description: List a market's tax zones. Returns paginated tax zones, searchable by name. Each zone carries `rate_count` — how many rate lines it holds — and `is_default` marks the market's catch-all zone if one exists. A market is not required to have a default zone: addresses no zone covers are sold with zero tax, and the tax calculation reports `tax_zone_unmatched`. Pagination and search bounds come from the limits endpoint. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-zones. Only the connected store is accessible.

search.description: Search by tax zone name.

name: list_market_tax_zones

description: Create a tax zone in a market. Creates a tax zone. `name` is required and unique within the market. A regular zone needs at least one country or subdivision; every country must belong to the market, every subdivision must be a known ISO subdivision belonging to a selected country, and duplicate subdivision claims or duplicate whole-country claims are rejected. A whole-country zone with an empty `subdivisions` array can coexist with state-specific zones: state matches win, then the country zone covers the rest. For example, a zone with `countries: ["IN"]` and `subdivisions: ["IN-UP"]` handles Uttar Pradesh; a second zone with `countries: ["IN"]` and `subdivisions: []` handles the rest of India. Only the matching zone’s rates apply. One zone can list whole countries and subdivisions of other countries together: each listed country with at least one listed subdivision is claimed only for those subdivisions, and a listed country with none of its subdivisions listed is claimed whole, except subdivisions other zones claim. So `countries: ["IN", "US"]` with `subdivisions: ["IN-UP"]` covers Uttar Pradesh and all of the US. Addresses are matched with country and state trimmed and case-insensitive, and a state matches a subdivision zone whether the address gives its ISO code with or without the country (`UP`, `up`, `IN-UP`) or its full name (`Uttar Pradesh`). When a country has subdivision zones and the address has no state, or one that isn't recognised, tax is not taken from the country zone: the tax calculation reports `tax_zone_unmatched: true` with `tax_zone_needs_state: true` and reports unresolved tax until a recognised state is given. Operational order creation is refused with `ORDER_TAX_ZONE_NEEDS_STATE` and `details.tax_zone_needs_state: true`; it cannot create a payable zero-tax order. A recognised state that no subdivision zone covers uses the whole-country zone. Setting `is_default` instead creates the market's catch-all zone for unmatched addresses. The optional `tax_exemption` object sets the business treatment: `exempt` removes tax only for a buyer marked tax_exempt by the merchant, and `invoice_only` keeps tax and marks the order for a business invoice when such a buyer, or any buyer who enters a tax ID, checks out. Fires `tax_zones/create`. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-zones. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

countries.description: ISO country codes belonging to the market. A listed country with none of its subdivisions listed is covered whole, except subdivisions assigned to other zones; a listed country with listed subdivisions is covered only for those subdivisions. Only one zone may cover a country whole, but it can coexist with subdivision zones. Empty countries and subdivisions are only valid for the default zone.

is_default.description: Make this the market's catch-all zone for addresses no other zone covers. The default zone must have no countries or subdivisions; promoting one demotes the previous default in the same write.

name.description: Tax zone name — unique within the market.

subdivisions.description: ISO subdivision codes (e.g. IN-KA). Each must belong to a selected country and not be claimed by another zone. Listing a subdivision limits the zone to the listed subdivisions of that country only; other listed countries are still covered whole.

tax_exemption.description: Business tax exemption for this zone: `{enabled, type, effect, checkout_text, custom_label, custom_placeholder, custom_pattern, custom_example, translations}`. Supported `type` values are `eu_vat`, `uk_vat`, `gstin`, `abn`, `gst_hst`, `ein`, and `custom`. `effect` is `exempt` (charge no tax, only for a buyer marked tax_exempt by the merchant; with inclusive prices, discounts, fees and thresholds settle once on the commercial amounts, then included tax is removed from items, shipping, COD and checkout fees. For example, 120 including 20% less a fixed 12 discount becomes 90. The order keeps `is_tax_included: true` with `tax_exempt: true` and zero `tax_total`) or `invoice_only` (keep tax and mark the order for a business invoice, for a merchant-approved exempt customer or any buyer who enters a tax ID at checkout). A tax ID never removes tax by itself, including in an exempt zone: tax is charged and invoice_only is recorded. Tringify performs offline format and check-digit checks only, with no live registration or exemption verification; merchants are responsible for tax settings and exemption approvals. Types must fit at least one zone country (market country for a default zone): eu_vat in EU countries, uk_vat in GB, gstin in IN, abn in AU, gst_hst in CA, ein in US, custom anywhere. Existing mismatches are returned as tax_exemption.type_mismatch=true without modifying stored settings; saving such a zone is refused. To turn the treatment off, send `{"enabled": false}`; leaving `tax_exemption` out keeps the saved treatment. `checkout_text` is limited to 100 characters. For `custom`, `custom_label` is required and limited to 50 characters; `custom_placeholder` is optional and limited to 50 characters. custom_pattern is optional RE2, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, matched against the entire normalized ID; no pattern permits free text. custom_example is optional, at most 100 characters, and must pass the pattern. translations maps en/de/es/fr/it to custom_label, custom_placeholder and checkout_text with the same limits. Built-in labels use checkout copy translations. Values are uppercased and spaces, dots and dashes removed before storing. EU VAT requires an EU country prefix (EL for Greece), national format and published check-digit rules (structural checks only for Czech nine-digit birth numbers and Latvian personal numbers); UK VAT uses GB with 9 or 12 digits and mod-97/9755 checks; GSTIN checks 15 characters, state 01-38/97/99, PAN shape and base-36 checksum; ABN checks 11 digits with weighted modulus 89; GST/HST requires a 9-digit BN with MOD10 checksum plus RT and a nonzero four-digit account number; EIN accepts NN-NNNNNNN. A valid GSTIN with a different Indian tax-address state is accepted and records tax_id_state_mismatch=true on the order.

description: Delete a tax zone. Deletes the tax zone. If it still has rate lines, the first call returns `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`; retry with `confirmed` and the returned `confirmation_token`. The token is for that number of rate lines: if lines are added before the retry, the zone asks for confirmation again. Cascaded rate lines do not fire individual `tax_rates/delete` events, so re-sync rates after the `tax_zones/delete` event. The default zone can't be deleted while it is the default. After deletion, addresses are matched again: any remaining state-specific zone wins, then a whole-country zone, then the default zone. If none matches, no tax is applied. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for DELETE /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-zones/{taxZoneId}. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

confirmation_token.description: Token from the CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response. Omit it on the first request and resend the exact same id selection when using it.

confirmed.description: On a confirmation retry, set this to true and send the returned confirmation_token. Omit it on the first request.

description: List a market's tax rates, filtered and paginated. Returns paginated rate lines — one row per line, a (zone, class) coordinate may hold several. Free-text `search` matches the zone or class name; `zone_id`, `class_id`, and `compound_mode` each narrow further. The response also carries the market's coverage figures: `total_combinations` (zones × classes) and `configured_combinations` (coordinates holding at least one rate) — server-computed so every client agrees. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-rates/search. Only the connected store is accessible.

compound_mode.description: Narrow by compound mode: added_to or compounded.

search.description: Free text — matches the zone or class name.

description: Create a rate line at a (zone, class) coordinate. Creates a rate line. `name`, `display_name` (what the customer sees on orders and invoices), `rate` (a decimal string, 0–100), `tax_zone_id`, and `tax_class_id` are required; `compound_mode` defaults to `added_to`. A coordinate may hold multiple lines (CGST + SGST), but each line name must be unique within its coordinate — a duplicate is rejected, never silently stacked. Fires `tax_rates/create`. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-rates. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

tax_class_id.description: The class half of the coordinate.

The service validates the final market state, so valid line-name swaps work and no intermediate write can violate a limit. Each written rate still emits its canonical create, update, or delete webhook. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-rates. A threshold is jurisdiction-specific and currency-specific, while the current rule is scoped to the market and tax class. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-price-rules/eligibility. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: get_market_tax_price_rule_eligibility

description: List a market's price-based tax rules. Each rule changes item tax for one tax class according to the final unit price after discounts. Rules do not apply to shipping, COD, or checkout fees. The class must still have an ordinary rate in each applicable zone. Where the matched zone's rates for the class add up to 0% (exports, zero-rated zones), the rule is skipped and no tax is charged; catalog price estimates skip it there too. While rules exist, the market cannot add a second country or currency or replace its currency (`TAX_PRICE_RULE_BLOCKS_CURRENCY_CHANGE`). Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-price-rules. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: list_market_tax_price_rules

description: Fetch one price-based tax rule. Returns the rule and its market, class, currency, threshold, and below/above rates. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-price-rules/{ruleId}. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: get_market_tax_price_rule

description: Create a price-based tax rule. Requires a single-country, single-currency market and allows one rule per tax class. The threshold is a decimal string in the market currency, compared with each item's unit price after discounts and before tax (for tax-inclusive prices, the price without tax at `below_rate`); at the threshold `below_rate` applies. The two rates must differ, but either may be higher. The class must have ordinary zone rates wherever the rule should apply: the rule's rate is shared between those rate lines in proportion to their ordinary rates, so CGST 9% + SGST 9% under a 5% rule are charged as 2.5% + 2.5%. In a zone whose rates for the class total 0%, the rule is skipped. Fires `tax_price_rules/create`. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/tax-price-rules. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

above_rate.description: Percentage from 0 to 100 with at most 4 decimal places, for items whose unit price after discounts and before tax is above the threshold.

below_rate.description: Percentage from 0 to 100 with at most 4 decimal places, for items whose unit price after discounts and before tax is at or below the threshold.

threshold_price.description: Positive amount, at most 99999999999.9999, using the market currency's decimal precision.

description: Learn which discount options and limits are available to this store. The response lists the accepted values and bounds for discount requests: the supported types, targeting and eligibility choices, percentage and priority ranges, relation caps, sort fields, page sizes, and the store's maximum number of discounts. Use list_default_limit for the initial page, page_size_options for page-size choices, list_max_limit as the upper bound for both per_page and bulk selections, and search_max_length for search text. `type_capabilities` lists which fields each type supports. Limits are store-wide: every market returns the same values, and the market id in the path is not checked. The sample shows current production values; read the response rather than hard-coding them. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discounts/limits. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: get_market_discount_limits

description: Browse the discounts configured for a market. Use this endpoint for a paginated discount list. You can filter by current status, discount type, or activation method, and search by name or coupon code. Search matches any part of the name or code, ignoring case. List records carry the discount definition plus worded labels (`status_label`, `type_label`, `value_label`, `usage_summary` and others); their targeting, eligibility, Buy X Get Y, bundle and gift arrays are always empty and `can_view_products`/`can_view_customers` are false. Read one discount to get those. Scheduled and expired statuses are calculated from the discount's dates when you read it. A `per_page` above list_max_limit is reduced to it, and sorting by `ends_at` lists discounts without an end date last. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discounts. Only the connected store is accessible.

activation.description: Return coupon discounts or automatic discounts.

page.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

per_page.description: The number of discounts to return on each page.

search.description: Search by discount name or coupon code.

sort_by.description: Sort by `priority`, `name`, `type`, `activation`, `usage_count`, `ends_at`, `created_at`, or `updated_at`. Defaults to `priority`. With `ends_at`, discounts without an end date sort last in either direction.

sort_direction.description: Sort in ascending (`asc`) or descending (`desc`) order.

status.description: Return only `active`, `scheduled`, `expired`, or `disabled` discounts. Scheduled and expired values are derived from the current time.

name: list_market_discounts

description: Add a merchandise discount to a market. Choose one discount type and provide the fields for that type. `value`, `amounts`, Buy X Get Y, bundle and gift fields sent for another type are rejected; `tier_value_kind` and `tiers` sent for a type other than tiered are ignored, and so are unknown fields. Empty money maps (`{}`) are treated as not set, so money maps from a GET can be sent back unchanged for any type. Percentage discounts use `value`; fixed-amount discounts use `amounts`; Buy X Get Y offers define qualifying and reward sets; bundles define every required component and either a set price or percentage reduction. Free gifts specify gift-only products and how they enter the cart; tiered discounts specify ascending base-currency subtotal thresholds and apply only the highest reached tier. Coupon discounts need a code that is unique within the market, while automatic discounts apply without one. Product, collection, category, customer, and group ids must belong to the same store. Free delivery is configured with the market's shipping methods. The response is the saved discount, with `usage_count` and `usage_held_count` at 0 and a matching `usage_summary`. A successful create publishes `discounts/create`. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discounts. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

activation.description: Use `coupon` when a shopper enters a code, or `automatic` when qualifying orders should receive the discount automatically.

amounts.description: Fixed discount amounts keyed by currency code. Include the store's base currency; additional entries must be currencies enabled for the market. Each amount must be greater than 0, at most money_amount_max, and fit that currency's minor-unit precision. A market currency without its own amount uses the base amount converted at the market's rate.

applies_to.description: Apply the discount to the whole order or to selected products or variants, collections, or categories. Buy X Get Y and bundle offers define their items separately and use `entire_order` here.

bundle_items.description: The products or variants and quantities required for one complete bundle. Provide between bundle_components_min and bundle_components_max different components. A `product` component matches any variant of that product; a `variant` component matches only that variant.

bundle_max_sets.description: The maximum number of complete bundle sets discounted on one order. Send -1 or null for no limit; an unlimited bundle is returned as null.

bundle_percentage.description: The percentage reduction for each complete bundle when the value mode is `percentage`.

bundle_prices.description: The price of one complete bundle, keyed by currency code. Include the base currency for fixed-price bundles; other market currencies without an entry use the converted base price.

bundle_value_mode.description: Use `fixed_price` for a set price or `percentage` for a percentage reduction on each complete bundle.

bxgy_buy_items.description: Simple products, exact variants, collections, or categories that can satisfy Buy X. Each item contains `item_type` (product, variant, collection, category) and string `item_id`. An item qualifies when it matches any target in the list. Bought and reward items are always different units, even when the two lists overlap.

bxgy_buy_quantity.description: The quantity a shopper must add from the Buy X set.

bxgy_get_items.description: Simple products, exact variants, collections, or categories that can be rewarded as Get Y, independently of Buy X targets. The shopper adds reward items to the cart; the discount never adds them. Whole variable products cannot be saved as product targets; select their exact variants.

bxgy_get_quantity.description: The quantity rewarded from the Get Y set.

bxgy_get_type.description: Make reward items `free`, reduce their remaining value by a `percentage`, or deduct a `fixed` amount from each reward item. The cheapest qualifying items are the rewards, whatever their order in the cart.

bxgy_get_value.description: The percentage off each reward item, or the fixed amount deducted from each reward item in the store base currency, converted to the order currency at the market's exchange rate. Fixed means an amount off, not a final selling price. The deduction is capped at the remaining reward-item value. Omit this field when rewards are free. Fixed amounts use the base currency precision and the live money_amount_max.

bxgy_max_uses.description: The maximum number of complete Buy X Get Y sets that may apply to one order: a whole number from bxgy_max_uses_min through bxgy_max_uses_max in the limits response. Omit it or send null for no per-order cap; unlimited_sentinel (-1) is not accepted here.

category_ids.description: The categories to discount when `applies_to` is `specific_categories`.

code.description: Required for coupon activation. Use letters A–Z, digits, hyphens and underscores, up to code_max_length characters; the code is stored in upper case. Codes are unique within the market and matched without regard to case.

collection_ids.description: The collections to discount when `applies_to` is `specific_collections`.

customer_eligibility.description: Make the discount available to everyone, selected customers, or selected customer groups.

customer_ids.description: The customers who qualify when eligibility is `specific_customers`.

ends_at.description: Stop the discount at this local store time. It must be later than `starts_at`.

exclude_sale_items.description: Skip items already on sale. Only percentage and fixed-amount discounts accept true; other types reject it with DISCOUNT_TARGETS_FORBIDDEN.

first_order_only.description: Restrict to a customer's first order. Earlier paid, cash-on-delivery or refunded orders under the same account or the same email address (ignoring case) disqualify; test and cancelled orders do not. Guests are recognised by email. An order with neither an account nor an email does not qualify.

gift_items.description: For free_gift: a gift-only product_id, positive quantity per cart, and optional variant_id. Omit variant_id for a simple product; a variable product requires the exact variant_id that belongs to it.

gift_mode.description: For free_gift: offer or auto_add. On create, omitted or null means offer; on update, omitted or null keeps the current mode. With best_for_customer ranking a gift ranks at its full value (each gift's quantity-specific unit price times its granted quantity) whether or not it is in the cart yet, including advertised coupons before entry. Gift-only units never qualify for other discounts or inflate their ranking. A gift grant is eligible only when its complete set is channel-available, priced, within quantity limits and in stock alongside all physical merchandise, including quantity-priced items excluded from discounts. Stacked gift sets share stock in ranking order; a set is granted only if its complete demand fits after higher-ranked gifts. When automatic discounts and codes don't combine, an offer the shopper hasn't claimed doesn't keep codes out; a code that applies withdraws the offer.

group_ids.description: The customer groups that qualify when eligibility is `specific_segments`.

max_discount.description: Cap the amount saved, keyed by currency code. Percentage, bundle and tiered discounts accept it; fixed-amount, Buy X Get Y and free gift discounts reject it with DISCOUNT_MAX_DISCOUNT_FORBIDDEN.

min_quantity.description: Require between quantity_min and min_quantity_max eligible items from the limits response. Percentage, fixed-amount and free gift discounts accept this condition; Buy X Get Y, bundle and tiered discounts reject it with DISCOUNT_MIN_QUANTITY_FORBIDDEN.

min_subtotal.description: Require a minimum merchandise subtotal, keyed by currency code. Include the base currency when you set this condition; other market currencies without an entry use the converted base amount. It is checked before any discount. For percentage, fixed-amount and free gift discounts it counts only the items matched by `applies_to`, leaving out items excluded by exclude_sale_items and a free gift's own gift items. Buy X Get Y, bundle and tiered discounts use `entire_order`, so it counts every item in the cart, not only the Buy X, Get Y or bundle items. Gift-only items and items left out by the market's quantity-pricing setting never count. Every type accepts it.

name.description: A name merchants can recognize when managing the discount.

per_customer_limit.description: The number of uses allowed for each customer. Send unlimited_sentinel (-1) or null for no limit, or a whole number from quantity_min through max_per_customer_limit in the limits response; an unlimited discount is returned as null. A customer is recognised by account or by email address, ignoring case, so guest orders count toward that email's limit; an order with neither is not checked. Orders over the limit are refused with DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER_LIMIT_REACHED.

priority.description: The discount's position when manual priority decides between competing offers. Omission uses 0 on both create and full replacement, which can conflict with another discount at that priority. Send an explicit unique whole number from priority_min through max_priority in the limits response.

product_ids.description: Products to discount when `applies_to` is `specific_products`. A variable product target includes all of its current and future variants.

refund_restores_usage.description: Give a use back to usage_limit and per_customer_limit when every item this discount reduced on an order is refunded, or the whole order is refunded. The use is returned shortly after the refund, following the setting the discount has at that moment. The release is final for that order and discount: payment capture or retry cannot reclaim it.

show_in_cart.description: Allow the storefront to show this coupon before checkout. Coupon discounts only; sending true for an automatic discount returns DISCOUNT_TARGETS_FORBIDDEN.

starts_at.description: Start the discount at this local store time, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss`.

tiers.description: For tiered: 1–10 tiers with strictly ascending min_subtotal thresholds from 0 to money_amount_max, and positive values, in the base currency and its precision. Only the highest reached tier applies, chosen from the merchandise subtotal before any discount. Percentage values cannot exceed 100. Fixed savings can exceed the threshold but are capped at remaining eligible merchandise at checkout; merchandise never becomes negative. Other markets use the base amounts converted at the market's rate.

usage_limit.description: The total number of uses allowed. Send unlimited_sentinel (-1) or null for no limit, or a whole number from quantity_min through max_usage_limit in the limits response; an unlimited discount is returned as null. A use is held when an order is placed and counts toward the limit while the checkout is unpaid, so new orders are refused with DISCOUNT_USAGE_EXHAUSTED once the limit is reached. The use is given back if the checkout expires unpaid or the order is cancelled. A payment that arrives after its checkout expired still keeps its use, which can take the count past the limit. A discount with no usage_limit and no per_customer_limit counts no uses.

value.description: The percentage reduction for a percentage discount. It must be greater than percentage_min_exclusive, no more than percentage_max, and use no more than percentage_decimal_places from the limits response.

variant_ids.description: Exact variants to discount when `applies_to` is `specific_products`. You may combine these with simple or whole-variable product targets, up to max_products_per_discount targets in total.

name: create_market_discount

description: Read one discount and its targeting choices. The response includes the complete discount definition and the ids it targets. Product-facing labels (products, variants, collections, categories, Buy X Get Y, bundle and gift items) are included when your token has `read_products`; customer names and group labels are included with `read_customers`. The ids remain available without those additional scopes, and `can_view_products` and `can_view_customers` tell you whether labels were included. The returned status reflects the discount's current schedule. `usage_count` includes uses held by unpaid checkouts; `usage_held_count` says how many of them are held, and `usage_summary` words both. Uses are counted only while the discount has a `usage_limit` or a `per_customer_limit`: with neither, orders record no use, `usage_count` doesn't change and `usage_summary` says uses are not counted. Adding a limit later counts uses from then on. `starts_at`, `ends_at`, `created_at` and `updated_at` are display strings in the store's time zone; `starts_at_iso` and `ends_at_iso` give the start and end as local store time in the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss` form that create and update accept. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discounts/{discountId}. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: get_market_discount

description: Replace the editable definition of a discount. Send the complete definition you want to keep, including all targeting and eligibility lists; read them with GET first, because list records leave them empty. The same type-specific rules used during creation apply here. Updating a disabled discount does not enable it; use the enable endpoint when it is ready to run again. Sending an unchanged definition leaves the discount untouched and publishes no webhook. A successful change publishes `discounts/update`. The response is the saved discount with its current `usage_count`, `usage_held_count` and `usage_summary`. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discounts/{discountId}. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

activation.description: Use `coupon` when a shopper enters a code, or `automatic` when qualifying orders should receive the discount automatically.

amounts.description: Fixed discount amounts keyed by currency code. Include the store's base currency; additional entries must be currencies enabled for the market. Each amount must be greater than 0, at most money_amount_max, and fit that currency's minor-unit precision. A market currency without its own amount uses the base amount converted at the market's rate.

applies_to.description: Apply the discount to the whole order or to selected products or variants, collections, or categories. Buy X Get Y and bundle offers define their items separately and use `entire_order` here.

bundle_items.description: The products or variants and quantities required for one complete bundle. Provide between bundle_components_min and bundle_components_max different components. A `product` component matches any variant of that product; a `variant` component matches only that variant.

bundle_max_sets.description: The maximum number of complete bundle sets discounted on one order. Send -1 or null for no limit; an unlimited bundle is returned as null.

bundle_percentage.description: The percentage reduction for each complete bundle when the value mode is `percentage`.

bundle_prices.description: The price of one complete bundle, keyed by currency code. Include the base currency for fixed-price bundles; other market currencies without an entry use the converted base price.

bundle_value_mode.description: Use `fixed_price` for a set price or `percentage` for a percentage reduction on each complete bundle.

bxgy_buy_items.description: Simple products, exact variants, collections, or categories that can satisfy Buy X. Each item contains `item_type` (product, variant, collection, category) and string `item_id`. An item qualifies when it matches any target in the list. Bought and reward items are always different units, even when the two lists overlap.

bxgy_buy_quantity.description: The quantity a shopper must add from the Buy X set.

bxgy_get_items.description: Simple products, exact variants, collections, or categories that can be rewarded as Get Y, independently of Buy X targets. The shopper adds reward items to the cart; the discount never adds them. Whole variable products cannot be saved as product targets; select their exact variants.

bxgy_get_quantity.description: The quantity rewarded from the Get Y set.

bxgy_get_type.description: Make reward items `free`, reduce their remaining value by a `percentage`, or deduct a `fixed` amount from each reward item. The cheapest qualifying items are the rewards, whatever their order in the cart.

bxgy_get_value.description: The percentage off each reward item, or the fixed amount deducted from each reward item in the store base currency, converted to the order currency at the market's exchange rate. Fixed means an amount off, not a final selling price. The deduction is capped at the remaining reward-item value. Omit this field when rewards are free. Fixed amounts use the base currency precision and the live money_amount_max.

bxgy_max_uses.description: The maximum number of complete Buy X Get Y sets that may apply to one order: a whole number from bxgy_max_uses_min through bxgy_max_uses_max in the limits response. Omit it or send null for no per-order cap; unlimited_sentinel (-1) is not accepted here.

category_ids.description: The categories to discount when `applies_to` is `specific_categories`.

code.description: Required for coupon activation. Use letters A–Z, digits, hyphens and underscores, up to code_max_length characters; the code is stored in upper case. Codes are unique within the market and matched without regard to case.

collection_ids.description: The collections to discount when `applies_to` is `specific_collections`.

name: update_market_discount

description: Delete, enable or disable selected discounts. Read discounts/limits first. The batch must contain between 1 and list_max_limit unique, nonzero UUIDs: this is exactly the maximum pagination size, not max_per_market. Empty, duplicate, malformed or oversized selections and unsupported actions are rejected before any writes. Each discount is then processed independently within the authenticated store and requested market. HTTP 200 may contain failed items; inspect every results entry and retry only failed ids. Successful changes are retained if another item fails. Enable resumes the schedule; it does not force a scheduled or expired discount to become active. Each changed discount records the discount and market names in the audit log and publishes discounts/update or discounts/delete together with the change. Unchanged status emits neither. Existing order snapshots remain unchanged. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discounts/bulk. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

ids.description: Unique discount UUIDs, at most list_max_limit from the limits endpoint.

name: bulk_market_discount

description: Remove a discount from a market. Deleting a discount prevents it from applying to future orders and removes its saved targeting and eligibility configuration. Existing orders keep the discount amounts that were recorded when they were placed. A successful deletion publishes `discounts/delete` with the deleted discount's identity. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for DELETE /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discounts/{discountId}. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.
name: delete_market_discount

description: Allow a disabled discount to follow its schedule again. After enabling, the returned status is `active`, `scheduled`, or `expired` according to the saved dates. Enabling a discount that is already enabled changes nothing. The response is the discount with its current `usage_count`, `usage_held_count` and `usage_summary`. A successful state change publishes `discounts/update`. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discounts/{discountId}/enable. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.
name: enable_market_discount

description: Pause a discount without deleting its configuration. A disabled discount does not apply to new orders and remains disabled until it is enabled explicitly. Disabling a discount that is already disabled changes nothing. The response is the discount with its current `usage_count`, `usage_held_count` and `usage_summary`. A successful state change publishes `discounts/update`. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discounts/{discountId}/disable. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.
name: disable_market_discount

description: Read how discounts are allowed to combine in this market. In `single` mode, one discount applies: every eligible automatic discount and every entered code are ranked together by `priority_mode`, and the first one wins. In `stack` mode, every eligible automatic discount applies, plus entered codes in ranked order up to `coupon_limit`; with `auto_coupon_combine` false, codes apply only when no automatic discount does. `best_for_customer` ranks by each discount's own saving; `manual` ranks by priority number, lowest first. Buy X Get Y, bundle and claimed gift offers use specific cart units, and two of them cannot use the same units: the higher-ranked keeps them and the other does not apply at all. Offers apply in three steps (Buy X Get Y, bundle and gift; then product, collection and category discounts; then order-wide discounts), and each uses the amount left after the earlier ones. With `apply_to_quantity_priced` false, quantity-priced items get no discount and do not count toward minimum spend, minimum quantity or tiers. Settings take effect the next time a cart or checkout is priced; placed orders keep their discounts. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discount-settings. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: get_market_discount_settings

description: Change how discounts combine in this market. Send only the settings you want to change; omitted or null settings keep their current values. `stacking_mode` accepts `single` or `stack`, and `priority_mode` accepts `best_for_customer` or `manual`. `coupon_limit` must be a whole number from 1 to the platform maximum, currently 5, and is checked in either mode; a value outside that range is rejected with `MARKET_COUPON_LIMIT_OUT_OF_RANGE`, and the error states the maximum. A new market starts with `single`, `best_for_customer`, 1, true and false. An unchanged request publishes no event; a successful change publishes `discount_settings/update` with all five settings. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/discount-settings. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

apply_to_quantity_priced.description: When false, items with quantity pricing get no discount and do not count toward minimum spend, minimum quantity or tiers. When true, they are discounted like any other item, on top of their quantity price.

auto_coupon_combine.description: In stack mode, true lets codes apply alongside automatic discounts; false lets codes apply only when no automatic discount applies. No effect in single mode.

coupon_limit.description: The maximum number of codes that may apply to one order in stack mode, from 1 to the platform maximum (currently 5). Automatic discounts do not count.

priority_mode.description: How discounts are ranked: `best_for_customer` by each discount's own saving, `manual` by priority number, lowest first. The ranking picks the single discount, fills the coupon limit, and decides which offer keeps items two offers both need. It ranks discounts one by one rather than searching for the largest combined saving.

stacking_mode.description: Use `single` to apply one discount per order, chosen by `priority_mode`, or `stack` to let every eligible automatic discount and up to `coupon_limit` codes apply together.

name: set_market_discount_settings

description: Get shipping settings. Returns persisted simple/advanced mode, simple currency maps, shared tax class, and HS code. Zone and method routes reject unless persisted mode is advanced. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/shipping-settings. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: get_market_shipping_settings

description: Update shipping settings. Save mode=advanced successfully before managing zones or methods. Limits can be fetched before activation. Sending mode=advanced alongside a zone or method does not activate shipping. The settings write switches modes atomically, clears simple amounts, and creates the immutable empty default zone. Configure its methods or add zones in subsequent requests. Advanced to simple returns CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, then permanently deletes every zone, method, and rate in the confirmed transaction. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/shipping-settings. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

confirmation_token.description: Token from CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.

confirmed.description: Confirmation retry flag.

flat_rate.description: Required base-currency decimal string plus optional exact overrides for other enabled currencies. Zero is allowed. Amounts use a decimal point, without currency symbols or grouping, and must respect currency precision and money limits. Missing overrides use base-currency conversion.

free_threshold.description: Required base-currency decimal string plus optional exact overrides for other enabled currencies. Every supplied threshold must be greater than zero and within the currency precision and money limit. At or above the threshold, post-discount merchandise qualifies for free shipping.

shipping_type.description: Free, flat, or threshold in simple mode.

threshold_rate.description: Charge below the free-shipping threshold: required base-currency decimal string plus optional exact overrides. Zero is allowed. Missing overrides use base-currency conversion; all amounts respect currency precision and money limits.

name: update_market_shipping_settings

description: Get shipping zone limits. Returns live zone name, description, search, pagination, and per-market limits. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/shipping-zones/limits. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: get_market_shipping_zone_limits

description: List available shipping countries. Returns market countries with country-fallback and explicit subdivision claims. fully_claimed means another country fallback exists; unclaimed subdivisions remain selectable. claimed_subdivisions lists explicit claims even when a fallback exists. Use exclude_zone_id while editing so the zone's existing claims remain selectable. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/shipping-zones/available-countries. Only the connected store is accessible.

exclude_zone_id.description: Zone whose existing claims should be ignored while editing.

per_page.description: Page size, capped by the service limit.

search.description: Search by country name or ISO country code.

name: list_market_shipping_available_countries

description: List shipping zones. Returns all zones in priority order, including the immutable default catch-all and each zone's method count. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/shipping-zones. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: list_market_shipping_zones

description: Create a shipping zone. Creates a non-default country/subdivision claim. For each country, no selected subdivisions means its fallback coverage. A separate Uttar Pradesh zone may coexist with India and no subdivisions, in either creation order; India then covers the remaining states. Duplicate country fallbacks or explicit subdivisions are rejected. The default zone is created only by the advanced-mode transition. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/shipping-zones. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

countries.description: ISO country codes. Each country without selected subdivisions is a fallback for its remaining regions.

is_default.description: Read-only invariant; false for create and unchanged for update.

subdivisions.description: Subdivision codes belonging to the selected countries. Explicit subdivision zones take precedence over country fallbacks. Duplicate subdivision claims are rejected.

name: create_market_shipping_zone

name: get_market_shipping_zone

description: Update a shipping zone. Replaces a zone definition. The default flag cannot be moved or cleared; the default zone cannot contain explicit regions. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/shipping-zones/{zoneId}. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

countries.description: ISO country codes. Each country without selected subdivisions is a fallback for its remaining regions.

is_default.description: Read-only invariant; false for create and unchanged for update.

subdivisions.description: Subdivision codes belonging to the selected countries. Explicit subdivision zones take precedence over country fallbacks. Duplicate subdivision claims are rejected.

name: update_market_shipping_zone

description: Delete a shipping zone. Deletes a non-default zone and cascades its methods and rates. If the zone has methods, retry with the confirmation token returned by CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for DELETE /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/shipping-zones/{zoneId}. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

confirmation_token.description: Single-use token returned by CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.

confirmed.description: Set true only when retrying after CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.

name: delete_market_shipping_zone

description: Get shipping method limits. Returns live method name/description and rates-per-method limits. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/shipping-zones/{zoneId}/methods/limits. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: get_market_shipping_method_limits

description: List shipping methods. Returns methods and exact decimal rates for a zone. Price tiers use min_values/max_values per currency. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/shipping-zones/{zoneId}/methods. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: list_market_shipping_methods

description: Create a shipping method. Creates free, flat, order-weight, order-value, item-count tiers (item), or per-item shipping (per_item). Per-item multiplies the unit charge by total shippable quantity before currency conversion and rounding. A matched weight, value, or quantity tier returns its configured shipping charge once. Every non-free rate requires a base-currency price. Other enabled currencies are optional exact overrides; absent overrides are converted from the base amount using the store currency conversion rate and rounding policy. Tier bounds are contiguous [min,max) ranges beginning at zero. Weight bounds use the saved weight_unit (g, kg, lb, or oz); create defaults to g. Value bounds are post-discount merchandise subtotals, and quantity bounds use the total shippable item quantity. description: Add a duty rule for one country in the market. The country must belong to the market, have a serving currency, and not already have a rule. Create an inactive rule while configuring rates; enable it once the required catalog data is ready. Default and HS-code rates may vary by origin country; use `*` as the fallback origin. Duty is charged on each line's customs value: its value after discounts (including payment discounts), without the tax its price includes. When `duty_includes_shipping` is on, the shipping charge without its included tax joins the customs value, and so does every checkout fee marked `counts_toward_customs_value`; both are shared across the rated imported lines in proportion to their value. Cash on delivery fees never count. Example in a tax-inclusive market with 20% VAT and a 12% rate: two items at 10 each with a 20% discount are 16, a customs value of 13.33, duty 1.60 and tax on duty 0.32; with 5 shipping and `duty_includes_shipping` the customs value is 13.33 + 4.17 = 17.50, duty 2.10 and tax on duty 0.42. The tax on duty uses each item's own tax rates and is always on top of the duty, never included in a price. Only when the market's `duty_collection_mode` is `collect_at_checkout` are the duty and its tax added to the order total (the tax is then part of the tax total); with `pay_on_delivery` they are the customer's estimate and with `included_in_price` your estimated cost, recorded on the order as `duty_total` and `duty_tax_estimate` and never added to the total. Estimates come from your own rules; carriers and customs may charge a different amount, including their own handling fees. A successful create publishes `duty_rules/create` with the complete saved rule. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/markets/{marketId}/duty-country-rules. Only the connected store is accessible. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

Send a decimal point without grouping or currency symbols.

description: Find catalog items checkout cannot charge duty on. Checks every enabled duty rule in markets with duties turned on against the shippable items of active products, the same way checkout rates them. Items whose origin is the rule's destination pay no duty and are skipped. For each rule it returns counts and up to 20 example items for: `missing_hs_code`, `missing_origin`, `missing_weight` (only where the matching rate is charged per kg) and `missing_rate` (no rate for the item's origin and HS code, and no `*` default), plus `unrated_origins`, the origin countries with no matching rate and how many items each covers. `currency_mismatch` is true when the rule's currency differs from the serving currency of its destination country: checkout then charges no duty to that country at all. Each example's `product_id`, and `variant_id` for a variant, identify the item to fix. `status` is `ok` when a rule has nothing to fix and `issues` otherwise; the top-level `status` is `issues` when any rule has one. At checkout, an item that cannot be rated pays no duty and the order goes ahead; staff and API orders containing one are refused with an `ORDER_DUTY_*` error. The report is computed for the whole catalog and may be up to 60 seconds old; `generated_at` says when it was computed. Markets list responses include `duty_health_available`, which is false when there is nothing to check. description: Turn password protection on, change the password, or turn it off. Takes effect at once, with no confirmation step. Send a non-empty `password` to protect the storefront with it: from then on every visitor must enter it, so a live storefront is hidden from shoppers immediately, and visitors who unlocked it with an earlier password must enter the new one. Send an empty string or null to remove protection and make the storefront public again. Leading and trailing spaces are removed; a password made only of spaces is rejected with `INVALID_INPUT`. A new password needs at least `password_min_length` (8) characters, counted as Unicode characters after removing those spaces; a shorter one is rejected with `STOREFRONT_PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT`. A password set before this minimum keeps working until it is changed. Sending the password already set, or removing protection that is not on, changes nothing. Development and transfer stores always stay password protected (`password_locked`). Password protection and the storefront's mode are separate; change the mode with Change storefront status. The password is never returned. The response has the same shape as Get a storefront (`storefront` with `password_protected`, `go_live`, `cache`). A change sends storefronts/update. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/password. Only the connected store is accessible. Tell the merchant what it will do and get approval first. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically; read the storefront first.

password.description: New storefront password, at least 8 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes, or an empty string or null to remove protection. Only spaces is rejected.

name: update_storefront_password

It must include the storefront's primary language, and every code must be a language enabled for the store (enable it first with Set languages). Codes are matched without regard to case; blanks and repeats are ignored. An unchanged list changes nothing. A change publishes storefront/locales/update. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/languages. Only the connected store is accessible. Preserve omitted fields. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

locales.description: Every language code the storefront publishes, including its primary language.

name: set_storefront_languages

description: Clear the cached pages of every storefront in the store. Clears the cache of all the store's storefronts, not just one: each page is built again on its next visit, so the first visits after a clear are slower. Saved changes publish on their own; clear the cache only when shoppers still see outdated pages. The cache can be cleared once every 12 hours per store, whoever cleared it last (Store Admin, the mobile app, an app or this API). Read `cache` in Get a storefront to see whether it can be cleared now. A clear inside the 12 hours is refused with HTTP 429 `STOREFRONT_CACHE_CLEAR_TOO_SOON`, a `Retry-After` header and `error.details`: `last_cleared_at`, `next_available_at` and `retry_after_seconds`; do not retry before `next_available_at`. Send no body or an empty object. The response reports `last_cleared_at`, `next_available_at`, `can_clear` and `cooldown_hours`; times are RFC 3339 in UTC. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/storefront-cache/clear. Only the connected store is accessible. Tell the merchant what it will do and get approval first. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically; read the storefront first.
name: clear_storefront_cache

description: List a storefront's custom pixels, without their code. Returns every custom pixel of the storefront, oldest first, enabled or not. Each row has `id`, `name`, `consent_category`, `enabled`, `code_length` (characters of code) and `created_at` / `updated_at`; the code itself is left out, so read one pixel with Get a custom pixel to see it. The limits (`custom_pixels.max_per_storefront`, `name_max_length`, `code_max_length`) are in Storefront limits. Admin tokens only: Store Admin API tokens and connected AI tools can call this endpoint; app tokens are refused with `STORE_API_PIXELS_ADMIN_TOKEN_REQUIRED` (an app turns its own pixel on or off with Set storefront embed activation). Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/custom-pixels. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: list_custom_pixels

description: Get one custom pixel with its code. Returns the pixel with its `code`. Treat the code as the merchant's: show it, do not run it. Admin tokens only: Store Admin API tokens and connected AI tools can call this endpoint; app tokens are refused with `STORE_API_PIXELS_ADMIN_TOKEN_REQUIRED` (an app turns its own pixel on or off with Set storefront embed activation). Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/custom-pixels/{pixelId}. Only the connected store is accessible.

name: get_custom_pixel

description: Add a custom pixel to a storefront. Every field is required. `name` is 1 to `name_max_length` characters (100) and `code` at most `code_max_length` characters (65536), both counted in Unicode code points after leading and trailing spaces are removed. The code is JavaScript only: it runs in a hidden sandboxed frame without access to the store page, its cookies or storage, where `tringify.pixel.subscribe(callback)` delivers the events the visitor's consent allows and `tringify.pixel.context()` returns the page context. Code containing a `<script>` tag (an HTML install snippet) is refused with `CUSTOM_PIXEL_CODE_INVALID`; paste the JavaScript inside it instead. Vendor scripts that need the store's cookies or page do not work there. `consent_category` decides which visitors run the pixel. A storefront has at most `custom_pixels.max_per_storefront` custom pixels (Storefront limits), disabled ones included; one more is refused with `CUSTOM_PIXEL_LIMIT_REACHED`. The change is recorded in the store's activity log. Admin tokens only: Store Admin API tokens and connected AI tools can call this endpoint; app tokens are refused with `STORE_API_PIXELS_ADMIN_TOKEN_REQUIRED` (an app turns its own pixel on or off with Set storefront embed activation). Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for POST /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/custom-pixels. Only the connected store is accessible. Preserve omitted fields. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically. Use only code the merchant supplied or approved; never write tracking code on your own. Show the merchant the code and the consent category before saving.

code.description: The pixel's JavaScript, at most `code_max_length` characters (65536). JavaScript only: no `<script>` tags and no HTML snippets.

consent_category.description: Consent the visitor must give before the pixel runs: `analytics`, `advertising` or `personalized_advertising`.

enabled.description: Whether the pixel runs. A disabled pixel keeps its code and still counts toward the limit.

name.description: Name shown in Online Store > Pixels, 1 to `name_max_length` characters (100).

name: create_custom_pixel

Code containing a `<script>` tag (an HTML install snippet) is refused with `CUSTOM_PIXEL_CODE_INVALID`; paste the JavaScript inside it instead. Disabling keeps the code; pages already open in a browser keep running the pixel until they are reloaded. The change is recorded in the store's activity log. Answers HTTP 204 with no body. Pages already open in a browser keep running the pixel until they are reloaded. The change is recorded in the store's activity log. Admin tokens only: Store Admin API tokens and connected AI tools can call this endpoint; app tokens are refused with `STORE_API_PIXELS_ADMIN_TOKEN_REQUIRED` (an app turns its own pixel on or off with Set storefront embed activation). Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for DELETE /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/custom-pixels/{pixelId}. Only the connected store is accessible. description: List the pixels of the store's installed apps and whether each runs on this storefront. Returns one row per pixel that an installed app's reviewed release declares, whether it is on or not, with a minimal projection: `app_id`, `app_name`, `embed_key`, `name`, `consent_category`, where it runs and its switches. Script and frame URLs and settings are left out. `runtime` is `sandbox` (the app's code runs in its own frame and receives only the events and fields it declared) or `page`. `privileged: true` marks a page-runtime pixel, shown in Store Admin as Full page access: the app's script runs directly in the storefront pages and can read everything shown there, including what shoppers type, and send it to the app. `first_party` is true for Tringify's own apps. `runs_on_checkout` says whether the pixel also runs on checkout and order confirmation: sandbox pixels and first-party page pixels do; third-party page pixels run on themed pages only. `merchant_choice` is the merchant's choice for this storefront and `app_choice` the app's store-wide activation; either is null when never set. `enabled` is the effective state the storefront uses: the merchant's choice when made, otherwise the app's, and always off while the app has switched its pixel off (`app_choice: false`). Installing an app turns none of its pixels on; uninstalling removes its switches, so a reinstalled app starts off. Admin tokens only: Store Admin API tokens and connected AI tools can call this endpoint; app tokens are refused with `STORE_API_PIXELS_ADMIN_TOKEN_REQUIRED` (an app turns its own pixel on or off with Set storefront embed activation). Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/app-pixels. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: list_app_pixels

description: Record the merchant's choice for one app pixel on one storefront. Sets `merchant_choice` for this storefront only; other storefronts keep theirs. The merchant's choice wins over the app's store-wide activation: off stays off whatever the app does, and on runs the pixel unless the app itself has switched it off (`app_choice: false`), in which case `enabled` stays false. Turning on a pixel with `privileged: true` that is not enabled yet needs `acknowledge_privileged: true`, sent only after the merchant confirmed they trust the app with full page access (and, when `runs_on_checkout` is true, on checkout and order confirmation, where shoppers enter contact, address and payment choices); without it the request is refused with `APP_PIXEL_PRIVILEGED_ACK_REQUIRED` and nothing changes. Turning on a pixel that is already enabled, or turning one off, needs no acknowledgement. This switch controls only the pixel in the browser: the app's server-side event delivery is unaffected and is managed in the app. Pages already open in a browser keep their pixels until they are reloaded. The answer is the pixel as List app pixels returns it; its `enabled` is the effective state. The change is recorded in the store's activity log. Admin tokens only: Store Admin API tokens and connected AI tools can call this endpoint; app tokens are refused with `STORE_API_PIXELS_ADMIN_TOKEN_REQUIRED` (an app turns its own pixel on or off with Set storefront embed activation). Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/app-pixels/{appId}/{embedKey}. Only the connected store is accessible. Preserve omitted fields. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically. Before turning on a pixel with privileged: true that is not enabled, tell the merchant that the app's code will run directly on their storefront pages and can read everything shown there (and, when runs_on_checkout is true, checkout and order confirmation), and set acknowledge_privileged: true only after they confirm.

acknowledge_privileged.description: Set true only after the merchant confirmed they trust the app with full page access. Required to turn on a pixel with `privileged: true` that is not enabled yet.

app_id.description: App id from List app pixels.

embed_key.description: The pixel's `embed_key` from List app pixels.

enabled.description: The merchant's choice: true to turn the pixel on for this storefront, false to turn it off.

name: set_app_pixel

description: List a storefront's title pattern and share image overrides by language and country. Each override applies to one `locale` and, when `country_code` is set, only to shoppers in that country; an empty `country_code` applies in every country. A null field uses the next broader setting. For a page in a language and country the storefront takes each field from the override for that language and country, then the override for that language, then the storefront's `title_template` and the store's share image. An empty `title_template` means no pattern for that language: generated titles then follow `add_store_name_to_page_titles`, which is store-wide. A pattern replaces the automatic store-name suffix. Patterns shape generated titles only; titles saved on a page are final. Images include `share_image_url`. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/seo/overrides. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: list_storefront_seo_overrides

description: Create or change the title pattern or share image for one language, or one language in one country. Omit `country_code`, or send an empty string, for the language-wide override; send a country code for that country only. This is a patch: an omitted field keeps its value (a new override starts with both null). `null` makes a field use the next broader setting. An empty `title_template` sets no pattern for this language; an empty `share_image_id` is the same as null. At least one field must stay set, otherwise the request fails with `SEO_OVERRIDE_EMPTY`: remove the override with Delete an SEO override instead. `title_template` may use only `{{ page_title }}` and `{{ shop_name }}` and is at most 200 characters (Unicode code points). Assigning a share image requires `read_site_assets` and a site-asset image from this store. A change sends storefront/seo_overrides/update. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/seo/overrides/{locale}. Only the connected store is accessible. Preserve omitted fields. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Omit or send an empty string for every country.

locale.description: A language the storefront publishes, including its primary language.

share_image_id.description: Site-asset image shared by pages without their own image. Empty or null to use the next broader setting.

title_template.description: Title pattern for this language or country. Empty for no pattern; null to use the next broader setting.

name: set_storefront_seo_override

description: Remove the title pattern and share image override for one language, or one language in one country. Pass `country_code` to remove that country's override; omit it to remove the language-wide override. Removing the language-wide override keeps its country overrides. Pages then use the next broader setting. A removal sends storefront/seo_overrides/delete. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for DELETE /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/seo/overrides/{locale}. Only the connected store is accessible. Preserve omitted fields. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the override to remove. Omit for the language-wide override.

locale.description: A language the storefront publishes, including its primary language.

name: delete_storefront_seo_override

description: Get source SEO for a storefront's home, shop or search page. Returns the search-result and social-share text, social image and robots settings with, for each, its generated default and whether the page still uses it (`*_is_default`). A page nobody has edited returns its generated defaults. These are the values for the store's default language. In another language the storefront uses that language's translation and, where a field has none, the generated default for that language, never the default-language text. Generated copy exists in ar, bn, cs, da, de, en, es, fi, fr, he, id, it, ja, ko, ms, nb, nl, no, pl, pt, pt-BR, pt-PT, ru, sv, th, tr, vi, zh, zh-CN and zh-TW; other languages get the English generated copy. A country row (Get country page SEO) overrides a field for shoppers in one country and language. A title saved here or in a translation or country row is final: the title pattern and the store-name suffix apply only to generated titles. A generated title is the page name formatted by the effective title pattern for that language and country; with no pattern, the store name is appended when `add_store_name_to_page_titles` is on. Robots settings and the social image are shared by all languages unless a country row sets them. The home page's generated title is the store name. The shop page defaults to noindex while it lists no products. A search with a query (`q`) is always `noindex,follow`; these settings apply to the search page without one. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/page-seo/{pageType}. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: get_storefront_page_seo

description: Update source SEO for a storefront's home, shop or search page. This is a patch: omitted fields remain unchanged and an empty string clears a text field. To return a field to its generated default, send `null` for it or set its `*_is_default` flag to `true`; the flag wins over a value sent with it. The GET response carries the same flags, so sending it back unchanged keeps generated defaults generated instead of saving their current text. A title you save is final: the title pattern and store-name suffix are not applied to it. A source field with stored translations cannot be cleared until those translations are removed. Changing source text marks that field's translations outdated. Setting a non-empty `social_image_id` additionally requires `read_site_assets` and an image from this store's site-asset namespace. The response has the same shape as the GET. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/storefronts/{storefrontId}/page-seo/{pageType}. Only the connected store is accessible. Preserve omitted fields. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

robots_follow.description: Whether search engines may follow links on the page. Null returns it to the default.

robots_follow_is_default.description: `true` returns link following to the default.

robots_index.description: Whether search engines may index the page. Null returns it to the default: the shop page is not indexed while it lists no products, and a search with a query is never indexed.

seo_description.description: Search-result description. Empty or null returns it to the generated default.

seo_description_is_default.description: `true` returns the search-result description to the generated default.

seo_title.description: Search-result title. Empty or null returns it to the generated default.

seo_title_is_default.description: `true` returns the search-result title to the generated default.

social_description.description: Social-share description. Empty or null returns it to the generated default.

social_description_is_default.description: `true` returns the social-share description to the generated default.

social_image_id.description: Site-asset image UUID. Empty string or null returns it to the default share image.

social_image_is_default.description: `true` returns the social image to the default share image.

social_title.description: Social-share title. Empty or null returns it to the generated default.

social_title_is_default.description: `true` returns the social-share title to the generated default.

fulfills_online_orders.description: Whether this location fulfills online orders. Defaults to true when omitted on create.

Only active, merchant-managed locations can switch pickup on, the location needs a complete address (it is the pickup address), and `pickup_ready_in` is required while pickup is on. A pickup location does not need `fulfills_online_orders`: with it off, the location serves pickup only. A location deactivated later keeps the setting, hidden from shoppers until it is active again. The storefront offers it only while the location is active and only to shoppers in a market that includes its country. Defaults to false.

pickup_ready_in.description: When pickup orders are usually ready: one of `1_hour`, `2_hours`, `4_hours`, `24_hours`, `2_4_days`. Required while `offers_pickup` is true. Shoppers see it as a translated label. An empty string clears it, which is refused while pickup is on.

pickup_stocked_only.description: While a shopper shops for pickup at this location, list only products it stocks: products with stock records here, sold-out ones included (shown as sold out), and products that do not track stock. Delivery shopping is never narrowed.

postal_code.description: Postal, ZIP, or PIN code. Validated against the selected country's format. India PINs are checked against the India Post directory; unknown PINs and PIN/state mismatches are rejected.

slug.description: Optional slug. Omit to generate from name.
